messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: how to run a two stage analysis by mirt
parts:
You said:

"how can i use "mirt" for estimation of item parameters for completed data and than use those item parameters for scoring of all data (that is, two stage estimation method)?any help?"

You use mirt() to estimate a model, and then obtain the factor scores of said dataset via fscores(). If you have some other dataset to score, then use the response.pattern input to fscores() to obtain the estimates based on those response patterns.


Phil
